items.question: What does a website from Coday cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: number of pages, the extras you want and whether we supply texts and images. That is why we do not quote a flat rate but prepare a binding fixed-price quote after a free call. You only pay for what you really need, and the price does not change afterwards.

items.question: What happens after I request a package?
items.answer: I get back to you within 24 hours. In a short call of about 15 minutes we clarify goals and scope. Then you receive your fixed-price quote. The project only starts once you accept it.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: In two steps: 50% at project start, 50% only once the website is live and you have approved it. No hidden costs, no subscription.

items.question: Do I have to supply texts and images myself?
items.answer: No, that is not a requirement. We gladly use what you have. Missing texts and images are discussed in the first call and planned into the quote.

items.question: Can I upgrade to a bigger package or add extras later?
items.answer: Yes. Every package can be extended later because they all share the same technology. Extras such as an online shop or a client area are simply added.

items.question: What ongoing costs should I expect?
items.answer: The website itself runs without a mandatory contract. Thanks to modern technology, hosting is very affordable and low-maintenance. If you prefer not to deal with anything, you can add the voluntary worry-free care, cancellable monthly.

items.question: What if I do not like the result?
items.answer: You see drafts and interim versions before the site goes live and approve every phase. On top of that our guarantees apply: fixed price, top Google scores at launch and the website belongs to you 100%.
